<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 3 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Book 3 ==

== Biography ==

The Nome King rules a kingdom from an underground palace, where he holds captive the wife and ten children of Evoldo, the former King of Ev, having enslaved them there. By his own account, he transformed the Queen of Ev and her children into articles of ornament and bric-a-brac scattered through his apartments, sparing them physical labor — a fate he describes as an act of kindness rather than cruelty, a characterization contested by those who come seeking their release. He also possesses a magic belt, later handed over to Ozma. Tiktok, addressing the assembled Army of Oz on the eve of the campaign against him, describes the Nome King as "hon-est and good na-tured," though this assessment stands at odds with the very expedition mounted to free his prisoners.

From Dorothy's perspective, the Nome King is said to have challenged Ozma to identify the enchanted members of the royal family among his ornaments within a set number of guesses, on pain of Ozma herself being turned into an ornament should she fail.

== Relationships ==

'''[[DOROTHY]]''' — enemy. An exchange accusing him of having been "cheated" suggests hostility between the two.
'''[[Ozma]]''' — enemy. Ozma's assembling of the Army of Oz toward making him "liberate the prisoners" suggests she regards him as an adversary.
'''[[BILLINA]]''' — enemy. A declaration of having "saved you from the Nome King, and you are a slave no longer" suggests Billina acted to free a captive from him.
'''[[Queen of Ev]]''' — enemy. He enslaved her and her ten children and transformed them into ornaments, an act he frames as kindness but which seems to set him against her.
'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — enemy. Their recurring association suggests the Scarecrow, too, stood opposed to him, though no direct exchange between them is given.

== References ==

<references/>

=== Events ===

* Ozma leads an expedition of Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, Billina, the Cowardly Lion, and an army of Oz to free the Queen of Ev and her ten children from the Nome King.
* The party passes a giant iron hammer-wielding guardian and reaches the Nome King's underground palace.
* The Nome King challenges Ozma to identify the enchanted royal family among his ornaments in eleven guesses, or become an ornament herself.
* Billina overhears the Nome King reveal that the Ev family are hidden as purple ornaments and the Oz party as green ones, then uses this secret to free everyone except the Tin Woodman.

<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 4 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Book 4 ==

== Biography ==

The Nome King is the former possessor of the Magic Belt, an artifact described as much more powerful than the Silver Shoes. Dorothy once captured this Magic Belt from him, an event she recalls when explaining how Ozma can watch over her through an enchanted picture. The Yellow Hen later recounts having had adventures with the Nome King in the Land of Ev.
</div>
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 6 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Book 6 ==

== Biography ==

Roquat, also known as King Roquat or the Nome King, rules an underground cavern beyond the Land of Ev. He once held captive members of the Royal Family of Ev, until Ozma marched there with Dorothy and her army and forced him to liberate them. During that encounter the Scarecrow nearly frightened him into fits by throwing one of Billina's eggs at him, and Dorothy captured his Magic Belt, carrying it away to the Land of Oz.

According to the Tin Woodman, Roquat does not have a kind heart and has harbored thoughts of revenge since his defeat, the liberation of his slaves, and the loss of his Magic Belt. He ordered his Nomes to dig a long tunnel beneath the desert so that he might march his forces into the Emerald City. Dorothy recalls that the Scarecrow once conquered the whole of the Nome King's army using some of Billina's eggs.

== Narrative role ==

Roquat, known also as King Roquat and as the Nome King, is revealed by Nick Chopper to have ordered a tunnel dug beneath the desert so that his forces, joined by the Whimsies, the Growleywogs, and the Phanfasms, might invade Oz — a plan Ozma had already glimpsed in her Magic Picture.

The Scarecrow's secret countermeasure then succeeds: dust scattered in the tunnel leaves the invading host thirsty, and once they drink from the Forbidden Fountain their hostility is forgotten. Roquat resists but is thrown into the Fountain along with his allies, after which Ozma banishes the rest of the invaders home using the Magic Belt.

== Personality ==

Roquat, aussi appelé King Roquat ou Nome King, se révèle sans bonté : selon les mots du Tin Woodman, « the Nome King has not a kind heart ». Cette dureté se double d'une rancune froide et patiente plutôt que d'un emportement passager — vaincu et privé de sa Ceinture Magique, il nourrit depuis des pensées de vengeance et fait creuser par ses Nomes un long tunnel sous le désert pour marcher sur la Cité d'Émeraude, signe d'une préméditation méthodique.

L'épisode où le Scarecrow faillit le faire sombrer en crise de panique en lui jetant un œuf de Billina suggère aussi une peur vive et disproportionnée face à une menace en apparence anodine, une fragilité qui tranche avec sa réputation de souverain redoutable.

Son propos adressé au General Guph — regretter de ne pas l'avoir nommé général plus tôt — semble indiquer, chez lui, une capacité, rare, à reconnaître une faute envers un subordonné. Son échange avec le Grand Gallipoot (« Don't let us quarrel now, friends ») pourrait de même suggérer une alliance entretenue avec effort plutôt qu'une confiance naturelle envers ses partenaires de guerre.

== Appearance ==

Roquat is referred to as the old monarch, ruling from his underground cavern beyond the Land of Ev.

== Powers ==

Roquat's authority as King of the Nomes was bound to a Magic Belt, an artifact of power that Dorothy captured from him and carried away to the Land of Oz.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Ozma]]''' — enemy. Their conflict seems to trace back to the time Ozma marched with Dorothy and an army into his underground cavern, beyond the Land of Ev, and forced him to liberate the captives belonging to the Royal Family of Ev.

'''[[General Guph]]''' — employment. An exchange in which he tells Guph, "I'm sorry I did not make you my General before," suggests Guph serves under him as a general in his forces.

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — enemy. Their rivalry appears linked to the moment Dorothy captured his Magic Belt and carried it away to the Land of Oz.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — enemy. This antagonism seems to stem from an episode in which the Scarecrow, using one of Billina's eggs, reportedly frightened him into fits, and in which the Scarecrow is said to have once conquered his entire army with Billina's eggs.

'''[[Grand Gallipoot]]''' — wary alliance. Their association suggests a cautious cooperation, hinted at by an appeal that "friends" not quarrel among themselves.

== Trivia ==

* Les œufs de Billina semblent constituer une faiblesse particulière chez Roquat : un seul œuf lancé par l'Épouvantail a suffi à le plonger dans des crises de panique, et son armée tout entière aurait déjà été vaincue par plusieurs de ces mêmes œufs.

== References ==

<references/>

=== Events ===

* The Tin Woodman reveals Ozma saw in her Magic Picture that the Nome King dug a tunnel under the desert to invade Oz alongside the Whimsies, Growleywogs, and Phanfasms.
* The Scarecrow's secret plan succeeds: dust in the tunnel makes the invading army thirsty, they drink from the Forbidden Fountain and forget their hostility, the resistant Nome King is thrown in too, and Ozma banishes the rest home with the Magic Belt.
</div>
